notes.title: Dev Update: New Enemies, Magic Spells, Weapons and Locations
notes.content:
Hi Steam Community,
I've been hard at work filling out the Mushroom Swamp biome with content. Here's a look at what I've been working on.

[previewyoutube=T2Ceo0CnjgU;full][/previewyoutube]

Structures
There are 6 new structures to discover and loot in the Mushroom Swamp. These range from abandoned towers to run down cottages and all contain valuable items for you to discover. The new structures are:

 Encampment Ruins
 Enchanted Tower Ruins
 Fisherman's Hut
 Gatehouse Ruins
 Mystical Cottage Ruins
 Shrine Ruins

Enemies
There are 4 new enemies in the game that can be found in the Mushroom Swamp.

Acid Blob
Look out these nasty dudes have a gross habit of vomiting balls of acid on unsuspecting adventurers.

Centipede
Watch your step. These nasty critters are easily hidden by the forest floor and love hiding in dark places. Their bite can leave lasting effects.

Reclaimed
These undead creatures, reanimated by the swamp itself can wield a variety of weapons including Hammers, Poison Gas Bombs and Bows.

Shroomling
Don’t let their unassuming demeanor fool you. Look out, he’s got a knife. Also, that big bouncy head isn't just for show.

Spells

Acid Ball
This projectile spell leaves an acidic residue on impact which can deal damage over time.

Lightning Bolt
This powerful beam spell deals high damage and can chain to nearby enemies or to you if you’re not careful ;)

Weapons

Silver Weapon Set
Silver weapons are the new highest tier. They can be found in the Mushroom Swamp and deal more damage and can remove more voxels.

Poison Gas Bomb
Throw to release a toxic cloud of gas on impact.

Artifacts

Jar of Fireflies
This jar of little critters when equipped will light up the darkness.

Lead Glove
This heavy glove will increase the knockback of your melee attacks when equipped.

That's all for today's update. Thank you all for the support :)

notes.title: Dev Update: The Mushroom Swamp
notes.content:
Hi Steam Community,
Let me start off by introducing myself for those who do not know me. I'm Tooley1998 and I am the developer of Lay of the Land. I have been creating games since 2014 and I have been working on Lay of the Land for at least 3 years.

I am going to start posting development updates to the games steam page to help keep everyone informed with the games progress who may not be following me on my social media pages. You can find those here  if you're interested.

I know many of you are eagerly awaiting news on the Steam release date for the game. While I am not ready to reveal a date just yet I will have more to say in the coming months. 

Anyway enough rambling from me here is a summary for some of the recent additions to the game.

[previewyoutube=xg9KX-sxU88;full][/previewyoutube]

Mushroom Swamp Biome

In this dark and gloomy biome you'll find ponds filled with lily pads cascading down into streams. Huge fig trees loom overhead with giant mushrooms and vines underneath. Dense vegetation litters the ground. I wonder what kinds of creatures, nasty and nice will call this place home.

New Animals

There are two new animals you can find in the Mushroom Swamp. The Hippo and the Anteater. Hippos love chilling out in ponds and looking for some tasty grass to eat. Anteaters like to spend their days searching the forest floor for their next meal.

New Building Materials 

With the new fig trees comes a new wood type: Fig Logs and Fig Planks. The giant mushrooms are the source of a few new building materials. Their caps are bouncy and their glowing undersides can be dyed a variety of colors to light up your builds.

Improved World Generation

The world asset placement system as been completely overhauled. Objects like trees, logs, rocks and more should now look much more natural. Terrain now should also blend better between biomes.

Peaceful Game Mode

I have added a peaceful game mode with no hostile creatures for those who just want to explore, build and chill.

That's all for today's update. Thank you all for the support :)
